SELECT sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, sys01_loc_nm AS loc_nm, a.total_size AS total_size FROM ( SELECT AS loc_nm , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' GROUP BY 1 ) a INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_loc_nm = a.loc_nm WHERE 1=1
AND ((#{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'true') = 'true') OR (#{useYn} = 'false'))
ORDER BY a.total_size DESC, a.loc_nm

SELECT TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'yyyy') AS period , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' AND = #{locNm} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'yyyy') ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'mm') AS period , ROUND(SUM(sys10_size)*(0.001), 1) AS total_size FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_server_path NOT LIKE '%KIDMS%' AND TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'yyyy') = #{year} AND = #{locNm} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'mm') ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_parent_id AS parent_id, sys10_reg_date::date AS reg_date, sys10_file_nm AS file_nm, sys10_server_path AS server_path, sys10_size AS size FROM find_orphan_sys10_files() ORDER BY sys10_reg_date, sys10_file_nm
